steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish core identifiers, namely setting the application name to 'Quick Notes' and defining the target package name.

steps.title: Define Build Steps Workflow
steps.description: Document the developmental roadmap structure in build-steps.json for structural execution tracking.

steps.title: Assemble Build Environment Configuration
steps.description: Structure the app/build.gradle buildscript pointing compile and target SDKs to 34 while maintaining clean standard dependencies.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest Requirements
steps.description: Draft AndroidManifest.xml outlining the core launcher activity, configuring theme styles, and implementing required system drawable references.

steps.title: Create Hexadecimal Color Scheme Definitions
steps.description: Formulate a clean, modern color palette with vibrant blue accents (#2196F3) and light backgrounds to elevate UI aesthetics.

steps.title: Configure Basic UI Theme Styles
steps.description: Map styles.xml to leverage Material Light parent components, defining base primary, dark and accent colors.

steps.title: Define Resource String Keys
steps.description: Assign the fundamental XML resource string identifiers for uniform naming conventions across components.

steps.title: Design Principal Layout Screen Structure
steps.description: Structure activity_main.xml to incorporate note inputs, functional buttons, clean text displays, and ListView scroll segments.

steps.title: Develop Note Item Template Row XML
steps.description: Formulate note_item.xml to present a structured row layout incorporating bullet markers, notes text, and standalone delete triggers.

steps.title: Construct Java Note Data Model Class
steps.description: Program Note.java to encapsulate persistent note objects containing custom sequential ID parameters and note contents.

steps.title: Build SQLite Local Persistence Layer Helper
steps.description: Construct NotesDatabaseHelper.java subclassing SQLiteOpenHelper to initialize, update, insert, fetch, and clear persisted notes safely.

steps.title: Implement Structured Note ListView Adapter Class
steps.description: Engineer NoteAdapter.java to bind collection items into list interfaces, managing deletion callback responses gracefully.

steps.title: Program MainActivity Lifecycles and Logics
steps.description: Code MainActivity.java handling user operations, local SQLite lookups, dynamic updates, and custom alert feedbacks.

steps.title: Secure App State Validations
steps.description: Ensure code limits empty strings inputs from executing and verify SQLite transactions complete gracefully to avoid device crashes.

steps.title: Building Quick Notes
steps.description: Execute Gradle debugging procedures on Java compiler outputs to build complete application binaries.
